purpose: A second frozen set, for the builder rather than for clustering.
note: personas.json deliberately contains needs nothing can close — PDF parsing, OCR, uptime monitoring — because it was written to measure whether clustering finds needs, not whether anything can meet them. That makes it useless for testing the builder: every need in it fails for the same reason, and none of them exercise the path where generation succeeds. This set is the opposite. Every need here IS closable by a real, free, keyless HTTPS API that is not in the registry, so a failure to close one is a failure of the builder rather than of the world. Same rules as the other set: frozen by checksum before any run, labels written first, and every caller minted --simulated so none of it reaches the public board.
